post.title: InDesign wants $22.99 a month. Papercut Studio wants nothing.
post.caption: Three fresh grudges: a desktop publishing subscription, a fitness app that bills by the year, and soundboards that charge to play a clip.

segments.quote: Why should the craft of arranging thought upon paper require rent paid to a landlord in San Jose?

cues.say: MyFitnessPal wants seventy-nine ninety-nine a year.

segments.quote: I wanted a soundboard for gaming and streaming without paying a subscription or dealing with loads of extra features.
